Lists the filtering capabilities available for scan configurations for endpoints that support scan configuration filtering.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.SCAN_WAS.READ` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles) and [Permissions](doc:permissions).

params.name: config_id
params.description: The UUID of the scan configuration that was used for the scan.

Lists the filtering capabilities available for scans for endpoints that support scan filtering.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.SCAN_WAS.READ` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Lists the filtering capabilities available for user-defined templates for endpoints that support user-defined template filtering.
Requires either the Scan Operator [24] user role, the `WAS.SCAN_WAS.MANAGE` custom role privilege, or the `WAS.SCAN_WAS_USER_TEMPLATE.READ` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.description: The UUID of the scan for which you want to list available findings filters.
